title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Handle
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：door　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 door 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my grandmother ① painted a door that no visitor in the hall would have opened, and she said the painting was the whole of the autumn. The ② door, meaning the panel and not the chance, stood fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a door, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unopened.

Every ③ door in that hall had the same short handle at the side of it, and the ④ door at the end, meaning the one they kept for the kitchen and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A door, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to open; my grandmother said the opening is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the door was the whole of the story, meaning the chance and not the panel. The ⑥ door, meaning the chance and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody knocks at and nobody enters; door, she said, is either something you paint or the only word that means both a panel and a chance. She said the chance is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ door had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short handle. The ⑧ door of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in October, was one hall and fourteen autumns of opening; door, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to open. She said the opening was never mentioned.

The ⑨ door I remember is the one numbered in the plan, which was replaced in 1969 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ door, my mother said in 1971, is the only one that improves by being opened; every door, she said, is a chance that has agreed to look like a panel. She said the chance was the honest half.

answers.why: paint a door 意为“给一扇门刷漆”，1948 年祖母给一扇门刷了漆，门厅里没有一位客人肯去开它。
door 意为“门”，指那扇门板本身而不是机会，它立了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
door 意为“门”，指那条门厅里的每一扇门，每一扇侧边都有同一个短短的把手。
door 意为“门”，指留给厨房用的那一扇，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
door 意为“机会、门路”，指故事里人人去敲却无人进去的那样东西，姑姑说这个机会就是那个故事的全部。
door 意为“机会、门路”，指人人去敲却无人进去的那种东西而不是那扇门板，是故事里人人都敲、却无人进去的东西。
door 意为“门”，指图纸上写到、被标号的那一扇，到 1957 年这扇门成了图纸里的一行。
door 意为“门”，祖母十月写道，整件事的门户之事是一条门厅和十四个秋天的开门。
door 意为“门”，我记得的是图纸上标号的那扇，1969 年被换掉了，至今仍被说成门厅里最安静的一扇。
door 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，一扇门是唯一会因为被好好打开而变得更好的东西。
